newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania launches tender for $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania launches tender for $100 mln loan.

text.p: The finance ministry of the Baltic state of Lithuania said on Wednesday that it had launched a tender for a manager to arrange a $100 million syndicated loan with a revolving credit facility.
"We expect a medium-term syndicated loan of three to five years, or more," the head of the finance ministry's market operations division, Ramunas Lygis, told Reuters.
"The loan will be used for cash management purposes," Lygis said.
Offers for the tender are expected before July 29, Lygis added.
"The interest rate should reflect the current borrowing costs of our recently launched Eurobond," he said.

It recently distributed a five-year, $200 million eurobond with a coupon of 7.125 percent.
